profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I'm a Senior Software Engineer with over 10 years of experience building vehicle navigation software, developer tools, and aviation web services.

I take a pragmatic approach: understand the problem, keep it simple, ship something worth using.

I work best in small, focused teams — fixed cycles, one complete feature at a time.

Let's build.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (AeroData)
positions.description:
Refactored a legacy .NET web application by migrating table-based layouts to CSS Grid and Flexbox, reducing HTML payload by 70% and significantly improving UI clarity and maintainability.

Rebuilt and modernized a legacy VB service into a lean C# CLI, eliminating Google Time Zone API dependency and reducing operational and monitoring costs.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Authored and distributed technical articles on system design, architectural patterns, and Git/PR workflows, scaling mentorship impact across multiple engineering teams.

Elected to Aviation Tech Guild; drove cross-functional initiatives improving engineering process, documentation, and testing standards across the Aviation Services organization.

Owned Angular front-end architecture and test strategy for Garmin PilotWeb, delivering complex multi-page flight and aircraft forms under rapidly shifting requirements.

Developed and deployed a TypeScript Cloudflare Worker API serving authenticated airport data queries to pilotweb.garmin.com, enabling real-time CDN-backed data delivery at scale.

Implemented multi-display Android AOS IPC framework enabling synchronized instrument cluster media and navigation control, with third-party content streaming support for apps like YouTube.

Slashed test-suite runtime by 83% with a Rust CLI that parallelizes 16,000+ Google Test cases using a thread-pool with channel-based coordination and polished, synchronized output.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
Automated Git-branch-aware map data syncing via Python, saving developers up to an hour of manual setup work per day across the entire segment.

Designed hybrid cloud navigation system for Ford Mustang and F150 EVs, delivering subscription management, multi-threaded tile download queue, LRU caching, and online/offline failover in C++.

Led a 3-person team to overhaul a notoriously bug-prone lane guidance system into a modular C++ pipeline with compile-time customer logic isolation, shipping the rewrite with zero defects.
